prompt: Subject: Afternoon raising a white heel Main Subject: A woman in her 20s sitting on the floor by a pale beige wall, stretching one leg high toward the upper right. Person/Expression: A slender oval face with a small chin, long dark brown eyes, thin natural eyebrows, a small nose, and pale coral lips. A calm expression looking straight at the camera over her shoulder. Dark brown long hair to the waist, thin bangs, loose waves flowing to the back, and a large white ribbon at the back of the head. Clothing/Pose: A white thin long-sleeved shirt-style mini dress. Clarify the wide neckline with dropped shoulders, loose sleeves, and the thin tie strings at the waist sides. White square-toe instep strap pumps with low thick heels. Place both hands on the floor to support the body, bend the person's own right leg on the floor, and stretch the left leg straight toward the diagonal upper right. Background/Light: The background is a pale gray-beige wall with decorative molding and a wood floor with distinct light and shadow. Introduce warm direct sunlight from the left, creating soft rim light on the hair, shoulders, and left leg, and casting pale window-frame-shaped shadows on the floor. Composition/Camera: Vertical 3:4. Capture the whole body with a front-facing camera at the same low level as the floor. Place the person's face and upper body in the left half, and the extended left leg and shoe largely in the wide space at the top right, with the bent right leg at the bottom right. Keep both hands and both shoes in frame, with a medium depth of field focusing on the face and the body in front. Texture/Style: A photorealistic live-action photo in soft indoor natural light. Finely depict skin texture, the gloss of long hair, the thinness and wrinkles of white cloth, the reflection of enamel shoes, and the wooden floor. promptZh: 主体：午后抬起的白色高跟鞋 主要对象：一位 20 多岁的女性 坐在浅米色墙壁旁的地面上，将一条腿向右上角高高伸展。将上半身置于左下角，长腿呈对角线向右上角延伸，身着 白色衬衫式迷你裙 和白色系带浅口鞋。人物/表情：纤细的鹅蛋脸，下巴小巧，深棕色长眼，细长的自然眉毛，小巧的鼻子，淡珊瑚色嘴唇。表情平静，越过肩膀直视镜头。深棕色长发及腰，留着薄刘海，波浪卷发自然垂向后背，脑后系着一个巨大的白色丝带。服装/姿势：白色薄款长袖衬衫式迷你裙。清晰展现宽领口、落肩设计、宽松袖子以及腰部两侧的细系带。白色方头脚背系带低粗跟鞋。双手撑地支撑身体，右腿弯曲置于地面，左腿向右上方斜向伸直。背景/光影：背景为带有装饰线条的浅灰米色墙壁，木地板上有明显的明暗光影。从左侧引入温暖的直射阳光，在头发、肩膀和左腿上形成柔和的轮廓光，并在地板上投下淡淡的窗框状阴影。构图/相机：竖构图 3:4。使用与地面齐平的低角度前置相机拍摄全身。将人物面部和上半身置于左半部分，伸展的左腿和鞋子占据右上角的大部分空间，弯曲的右腿位于右下角。确保双手和双脚均在画面内，中等景深，焦点对准面部和前方身体。纹理/风格：在柔和室内自然光下的写实真人照片。细腻刻画皮肤质感、长发光泽、白色布料的轻薄感与褶皱、漆皮鞋的反射以及木质地板的纹理。负面提示：改变左腿向右上角伸展的姿势；面部特征发生显著变化。
